authority: User message 'MOTAR - Unattended Autonomous S-L1B/C/D Research Execution' (2026-10-18): conditional continuous approval of S-L1B, then S-L1C, then S-L1D, each gated on its own preregistered acceptance gates

frames.lidar: origin = vehicle origin, yaw-only frame (+x forward, +y left, +z up); azimuth bin j bearing = pi - j*2pi/H (decreasing); row e elevation = 20 - e*10 deg for V=4 (row 0 = +20 deg)
frames.camera: origin = vehicle origin + camera_translation (0.10, 0, 0.03) in the yaw-only frame; nominal mount rotation R = identity; camera axes +x forward, +y left, +z up
frames.extrinsic: p_lidar = R * (d * r_hat(u, v)) + t; implementation accepts general R and t

range_conventions.camera_obstacle_depth: S-L1A slant range along r_hat from the camera origin; >= 10 m - 1e-3 is no return
range_conventions.camera_target_depth: existing renderer slant range, far 20 m (unchanged)
range_conventions.lidar: slant range along the beam from the vehicle origin; no return = 12 m; returns below 0.2 m arrive as 0 m (existing clamp, unchanged)
range_conventions.fused_no_information: a bin without a valid camera point contributes 12 m (no information)

radius.unchanged_in_s_l1b: camera centre range = mean surface depth + 0.15 (EQ-1A A7 bias) and LiDAR association centre = surface + 0.15 (A4 -0.05 m) remain Known FAILs assigned to S-L1C's measurement model
radius.used_by_s_l1b_carve: predicted LiDAR proxy surface lower bound = camera-observed nearest body range - (0.20 - 0.15)

corrections.B1_pixel_bearing: pinhole intrinsics per pixel; no linear-in-angle column map
corrections.B2_common_origin: every valid camera depth pixel becomes p_lidar = R d r_hat + t; rho = |p|, az = atan2(y, x), el = atan2(z, hypot(x, y))
corrections.B3_binning: j = round((pi - az)/dAz) mod H; e = round((20 deg - el)/10 deg); strict per-elevation bins keep 0 <= e <= V-1; the actor-facing conservative envelope clamps e into [0, V-1]; bin value = minimum rho over valid points; rho >= 12 m ignored
corrections.B4_fusion: fused scan = min(LiDAR after carve, clamped camera envelope) over every bin (no hfov column gate)
corrections.B5_carve_common_frame: S-L1A candidate/count/fresh-camera rules unchanged; anchor_L = min over valid candidate pixels of |R d r_hat + t|; s_L = anchor_L - (r_lidar - r_camera); LiDAR carve window [s_L, s_L + 0.55) with zero tolerance below s_L; angular limit min(15 deg, asin(r_lidar/(s_L + r_lidar))); camera blank mask = S-L1A rule unchanged
corrections.unchanged: detector (S-L1A depth), camera target measurement, LiDAR association, tracker, covariance, obstacle token construction, 898-D schema, E-L0

robustness.pixel: S-L1A oracle robust pixel: all eight +-0.01 px neighbouring first-hit labels agree
robustness.bin: a bin is boundary-robust when its float64 oracle value is identical with every azimuth/elevation boundary shifted by -1e-5 and +1e-5 rad
robustness.grazing: pixels whose ray meets a box face at incidence > 80 deg from the normal are excluded from per-pixel metric gates and reported

cpu_fixtures.F1_front_plane: box face x = 5 m (body), y,z within +-20 m; on- and off-axis
cpu_fixtures.F2_bearings: 0.1 m x 0.1 m vertical bars centred at body bearings +-5, +-20, +-40 deg, body range 3 and 6 m
cpu_fixtures.F3_vertical: overhang box above the LiDAR coverage (elevation > 25 deg) and a low box below -15 deg; per-elevation rows versus clamped envelope
cpu_fixtures.F4_extrinsic: camera translation (0.20, 0.05, -0.04) and mount rotation pitch 10 deg, yaw 5 deg; oracle renders with the same pose
cpu_fixtures.F5_carve: S14 and A_FOREGROUND geometry plus B_TIGHT: on-axis target centre 3 m, bar return at body range 2.77 m (inside S-L1A's camera-frame window, nearer than the 2.80 m LiDAR proxy surface)
cpu_fixtures.F6_conventions: camera no-return, target-blanked pixels, depth <= 0, non-finite depth, LiDAR 0 m near returns and 12 m no-return

gates.B-POINT: per-pixel calibration on robust non-grazing obstacle pixels: |rho_prod - rho_true| <= 1e-4 m, |az| and |el| errors <= 1e-5 rad (CPU exact fixtures F1-F4 with float32 oracle depth; GPU fixtures with delivered depth against the analytic surface point)
gates.B-A1A2: the EQ-1A 20 deg counterexample and the front-plane on/off-axis fixture are re-run: S-L1B bearing error <= 1e-5 rad and body-range error <= 1e-4 m where legacy shows 3.41 deg / -0.0998 m; legacy values are reported, not gated
gates.B-ENVELOPE: production strict and clamped bins equal the independent float64 reprojection of the same depth image within 1e-4 m on every boundary-robust bin, 0 robust mismatches (CPU and GPU)
gates.B-VERTICAL: strict rows contain only in-band points; out-of-coverage points appear only through the clamped edge rows; the 2-D envelope (min over rows) never exceeds the legacy-equivalent conservative minimum of correctly mapped points
gates.B-CARVE: S14, A_FOREGROUND (CPU and GPU) and B_TIGHT (CPU) bar returns are never carved and never falsely cleared under s_l1b_v1; no unsupported carve; carve masks equal the independent oracle; target-return retention reported
gates.B-DEPTH: s_l1b_v1 delivered depth bitwise equals s_l1a_v1 in every sensor fixture; A-DEPTH thresholds hold (robust non-target max <= 1e-4 m, false-clear = no-hit false-positive = 0)
gates.B-REGRESSION: CPU: unset/off and s_l1a_v1 perception fusion and detector outputs bitwise equal to source 139184b on identical inputs. GPU: off digests equal historical EL0-R1 P2 and s_l1a_v1 digests equal SL1A-C01 on_p2 (all 14 keys, 600 steps, static 4501 and moving 4502)
gates.B-EL0: s_l1b_v1 with E-L0 P1 and P2 has identical closed-loop digests (static and moving)
gates.B-FIREWALL: S-L1B helpers accept only delivered sensor arrays and declared calibration constants (AST/signature test); actor width 898; no target/semantic/simulator pose input
gates.B-INTEGRITY: checkpoint, RMS, 898-D, import origins, source SHA, frozen tree, raw manifest valid; no NaN/Inf
gates.verdict: S-L1B QUALIFIED only when B-POINT, B-A1A2, B-ENVELOPE, B-VERTICAL, B-CARVE, B-DEPTH, B-REGRESSION, B-EL0, B-FIREWALL and B-INTEGRITY pass; otherwise FAIL or INCOMPLETE. GO to S-L1C requires QUALIFIED plus an independent review without an unresolved blocker.

not_gated_reported: per-beam envelope minus LiDAR beam truth (one-sided conservative offset)
fused scan and obstacle-token change versus s_l1a_v1
ON closed-loop observation/action/trajectory/outcome changes (no performance claim)
EQ-1D D2-F1 under its original beam-exact horizontal-range definition (an envelope is not a beam metric)

stop: off, s_l1a or E-L0 non-interference failure
